card.name: Partway through chemical drug names
card.fires_on: Pieces inside long chemical or drug names, such as the start of hydro- (hy-D-rochloride, hydromorphone), eth-yl, and -amino-, where the name is still unfinished.

modes.label: Hydro- names
modes.description: The d or hydro piece in hydrochloride, hydromorphone or hydrocodone.

modes.label: Other chemical names
modes.description: Middle pieces of systematic chemical names like ethyl, amino or trioctyl.

card.writes: It seems to push toward more name pieces and away from sugar and alcohol words.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long chemical or drug names, especially hydro- names, before the name is complete.
